text:
leo: dropping a small prototype for the time-range picker + sampling combo on the latency dashboard. main ask: is it clear that the sampling slider only affects the visual plot, not stored metrics? want minimal copy and a good keyboard flow.

anya: nice. UX concern: two places changing time (scrubber + quick presets) can be confusing. maybe move sampling controls into the chart header and keep the scrubber solely for range selection.

omar: +1. also suggest showing current sampling percent as a compact badge next to the chart title so users always know view is modified (e.g., "10% sample").

leo: agree on badge. mock idea: badge shows when sampling != 100%. clicking it opens a tiny panel with presets: Smoothed 10%, Balanced 50%, Full 100% and a small slider for custom.

anya: copy: change "Smoothed" to "Smoothed (10%)" so percent is explicit. tooltip should be: "Visual-only sampling: reduces plotted points for clearer trends; raw metrics unchanged." keep it short.

a11y-bot: accessibility items: presets must be buttons with aria-pressed, slider exposes aria-valuemin/valuemax/valuenow, badge updates announced via aria-live, tooltip dismissible with ESC. provide keyboard shortcut to open badge panel (press "S" when chart focused).

omar: visual affordance: when sampling active dim heatmap to 45% and keep p95 line on top with thicker stroke. provide solid vs dashed strokes for cohorts. include small mini-legend under scrubber to toggle series visibility.

leo: good notes. analytics: emit sampling_changed event with anonymized cohort/route key and percent. do not include raw metric values.

anya: keyboard flow suggestion for devs: 1) Tab to chart title, 2) press S to open sampling panel, 3) Arrow keys to navigate presets, 4) Enter to apply, 5) Tab to slider, 6) Arrows to adjust percent, 7) ESC to close, 8) Shift+R to reset sampling to 100%. add aria-live messages after each change.

a11y-bot: also add a screen-reader note when sampling is applied: "Sampling applied: view showing X percent of points; raw metrics unchanged." ensure this reads once per change to avoid spam.

leo: action items for me: 1) add badge + compact panel mock, 2) include explicit percent in preset labels, 3) dim heatmap and bring p95 lines forward, 4) add keyboard shortcut + flow doc, 5) wire analytics event name sampling_changed anonymized. i'll push updated mock tomorrow. thanks! :sparkles:
